stem:
Meena reads that natural forces like wind, rain and flowing water slowly act on rocks and soil near her village in Uttarakhand. Her teacher says a change is physical when no new substance is formed, and chemical when a new substance forms.

Which slow natural change is a physical change?

options.text: rain water dissolving minerals in rock to form a new substance
wind breaking a rock into smaller pieces of the same rock
iron in the soil rusting after years of contact with moist air
plant acids slowly reacting with the surface of a stone

teacher.key_rationale: Breaking a rock into smaller pieces by wind changes only size and shape; no new substance forms, so it is a physical change. Options A, C and D each involve formation of a new substance (dissolved/reacted minerals, rust, acid–stone reaction), so they are chemical changes.
